definitions.gloss: unauthorized reproduction; unauthorized reposting; reprinting without permission
definitions.explanation: Copying and republishing someone else's content (text, images, videos, etc.) without obtaining their permission. Extremely common on Japanese websites as a warning against unauthorized sharing.

examples.japanese: {無断転載|むだんてんさい}{禁止|きんし}。
この{写真|しゃしん}の{無断転載|むだんてんさい}はご{遠慮|えんりょ}ください。
examples.english: Please refrain from reposting this photo without permission.

examples.japanese: SNSでの{無断転載|むだんてんさい}が{問題|もんだい}になり、{著作権|ちょさくけん}{侵害|しんがい}で{訴|うった}えられた。
examples.english: Unauthorized reposting on social media became a problem, and a copyright infringement lawsuit was filed.

notes: Composed of {無断|むだん} (without permission) + {転載|てんさい} (reprinting, reposting). One of the most common copyright-related phrases seen on Japanese websites, blogs, and social media. Almost always appears as {無断転載|むだんてんさい}{禁止|きんし} (unauthorized reproduction prohibited) or {無断転載|むだんてんさい}はご{遠慮|えんりょ}ください (please refrain from unauthorized reproduction). Related: {無断|むだん}{使用|しよう} (unauthorized use), {無断|むだん}{複製|ふくせい} (unauthorized copying).
